facts.summary: Discontinued after PK failed to reach efficacy-required drug levels · Phase 2 · RLYB212 in FNAIT prevention · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The Company’s decision to discontinue RLYB212 development was based on pharmacokinetic (PK) data from the Phase 2 clinical trial demonstrating the inability of the RLYB212 dose regimen to achieve predicted target concentrations
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Second trimester PK results from the sentinel participant demonstrated an inability of RLYB212 to achieve predicted target concentrations of 6 ng/mL to 10 ng/mL, as well as the minimum target concentration required for efficacy of 3 ng/mL
evidence.program_discontinued: today announced the discontinuation of the RLYB212 program for the prevention of fetal and neonatal alloimmune thrombocytopenia (FNAIT).
